@[simps!]
def PlusU1 (n : ℕ) : ACCSystem where
  numberLinear := 4
  linearACCs := fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => @accGrav n
    | 1 => accSU2
    | 2 => accSU3
    | 3 => accYY
  numberQuadratic := 1
  quadraticACCs := fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => accQuad
  cubicACC := accCube
